notes: v509 — new report: 📏 Know Your Share, on every share's detail view under the 🎯 Trade Plan. It is built on the one thing last year's full replay proved reliable: you cannot tell which WAY a share will move, but how FAR it moves is almost perfectly persistent — shares ranked by their last month's movement kept that ranking into the next month with a correlation of 0.89. So the passport tells you, per share: its movement decile from 1 (quietest tenth of the shares you have loaded) to 10 (wildest), what that movement costs per $1,000 held — per day, week and month — BOTH honest parcel sizes for your chosen risk (sized to an ordinary day, or sized to being wrong — the stop-out cost of each stated plainly), the finest stop-loss that actually exists at that share's price step, how long it takes to sell out at a tenth of normal turnover, its worst stretch on record, and what is factually true today (streaks, accumulation days, RSI zone). Every line is arithmetic on stored prices. Nothing on it predicts direction — the replay found nothing that does, and the panel says so on its face. Research, not advice. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
